guidance.heading: Outlook
section: ◦(+) We expect record crushing in 2026, with mid-double-digit growth versus 2025 on greater cane productivity (including Caarapó from September 1 and assuming normal weather through year-end). Our continuous harvest model ensures any cane left unharvested at year-end will be crushed from January onwards.
◦(+) As of this date, 100% of our 2026 sugar production is hedged at an average of 16.5 cts/lb, and 41% of 2027 production at 18.3 cts/lb. Unhedged volumes provide upside exposure in 1H27.
◦(+) We are accelerating ethanol sales to capture stronger prices, supported by a higher demand due to the low parity at the pump.

desk.headline: Revenue doubles to $598m with fertilizer unit; EPS $0.32 below estimates; record crush expected for 2026, year-end leverage aimed at ~2.5x

other.label: Adjusted net income
other.change: vs $72.6m pro forma a year ago

results: Revenue nearly doubled to $598.4m, mainly because the Profertil fertilizer business, bought in December 2025, is now included.
Adjusted EBITDA was $213.4m, flat on a pro forma basis: stronger urea sales and dairy offset weaker sugar.
Profit was $51.7m ($0.32 a share), but adjusted net income fell to $37.9m on higher interest and tax.
September rain cut cane crushing 5.1%, though cane yields per hectare rose sharply.
Net debt rose to $1.81bn after the $136m Caarapó mill purchase; a final $17.5m dividend payment is due 19 Nov.

guidance.summary: Adecoagro gives a written outlook rather than number ranges: record 2026 cane crushing, fertilizer EBITDA above prior years, and leverage falling toward about 2.5x by year-end as working capital unwinds.

points: Management still sees yearly fertilizer EBITDA above $300m as reasonable, but said Q3 was lifted by sales carried over from earlier.
Q4 ethanol sales are expected to be about 200,000 m³ higher than Q3 at prices roughly 25% higher, helped by a government subsidy.
It is unclear whether that ethanol subsidy continues after 9 December.
Caarapó should crush 4–5 million tons in 2027; the company would be comfortable at 2–2.5x leverage.
A final investment decision on expanding the Profertil plant is targeted for 2027.
call.source: Press release (Exhibit 99.1) and call coverage: MarketBeat via Yahoo Finance, 12 Nov 2026

watch: Whether net debt falls toward the ~2.5x year-end target.
Ethanol prices and whether Brazil's subsidy is extended past 9 December.
Urea prices and volumes as South America's planting season ends.
